name: 面向销售的 SAP Fiori 分析应用 (1BS)
name_en: SAP Fiori Analytical Apps for Sales (1BS)
description_en_html:
Overview

For sales and distribution scenarios, this scope item provides key information required for a sales manager or internal sales representative about the different stages of a sales order. The analytical apps provided highlights back orders, demand fulfillment, sales order fulfillment and delivery performance in the sales process. An SAP Fiori overview page is also available that provides the different insight to actions about sales quotations, customer returns, sales order fulfillment and more.

Key Process Flow

  • Analytical and transactional display of the sales order processes such as sales quotations, sales order fulfillments, customer returns, back orders, demand fulfillment, delivery performance and so on
  • Filter KPIs for the different business attributes, such as sales organization, sales document type, sold-to-party and so on
  • Navigate from KPI insights to the corresponding smart apps for detailed analysis
  • Share high-level process KPIs and other high-level process information with the people responsible for process execution in a sales organization

Business Benefits

  • Perform daily activities smoothly using a dashboard of information for the internal sales representative or sales manager from the SAP Fiori Overview Pages
  • View delivery performance and sales order fulfillment as a mix of the table and chart visuals on the sales order process in the Analytical List Pages
  • Understand the key numbers with high-level insights for the sales manager to drill down to action
  • Provide status of the sales orders, sales quotations, back orders, unconfirmed orders and more
  • View a strategic and operational overview for the end-to-end sales order processes
description_zh_html:
概览

对于销售和分销场景，此范围项目提供销售经理或内部销售代表所需的有关销售订单不同阶段的关键信息。提供的分析应用突出显示销售流程中的延期交货订单、需求履行、销售订单履行和交货绩效。SAP Fiori 概览页面还提供对销售报价、客户退货、销售订单履行等操作的不同分析。

关键流程流

  • 销售订单流程的分析和事务显示，例如销售报价、销售订单履行、客户退货、延期交货订单、需求履行、交货绩效等
  • 过滤不同业务属性的 KPI，例如销售组织、销售凭证类型、售达方等
  • 从 KPI 洞察导航到相应的智能应用以进行详细分析
  • 与销售组织中负责流程执行的人员共享高级流程 KPI 和其他高级流程信息

业务优势

  • 从 SAP Fiori 概览页面使用内部销售代表或销售经理的信息仪表盘顺利执行日常活动
  • 在分析清单页面中，查看销售订单流程中的交货绩效和销售订单履行情况，同时显示表格和图表
  • 通过高级分析了解关键数字，以便销售经理可以下钻到行动
  • 提供销售订单、销售报价、延期交货订单、未确认订单等的状态
  • 查看端到端销售订单流程的战略和运营概览。
